name: Guardian of Time heirloom store hides heirlooms the account already owns (#9440)
contract: On Ascension the Guardian of Time's Heirlooms store 9781001 stops listing an heirloom once the account owns it in
its vanity collection, which delivers it for free. With CoA.UnlockAllVanity = 0 and Rethreaded Left Bear Claw
1518202 owned through CoA.StarterVanityItems, the store omits 1518202 and still sells the unowned Rethreaded Right
Bear Claw 1518203 at its ItemExtendedCost 36202 (96000 Runes of Descension 375250). Buying 1518203 adds it to the
collection, and the open store is sent again without it, so it disappears without reopening the vendor.

steps.label: Unowned Rethreaded Right Bear Claw is still sold
DISCRIMINATING: owned Rethreaded Left Bear Claw is not listed
Buy the Rethreaded Right Bear Claw
DISCRIMINATING: the open store is sent again
The bought heirloom is no longer listed
The rest of the store is still sold
